title: docs(changeset): date-note three pending entries on the pivot node's drillDown that PR #10972 made false (objectui#10974)
body:
Fixes #10974
Clause-②: no — release-note prose only; no accept set or public surface changes.

## What this does

PR objectui#10972 (objectui#10932, merged as `cc4e47638`) retired `drillDown` on the bare `pivot` node in this same unreleased batch: `PivotTableSchema.drillDown` is a `?: never` tombstone on the TypeScript face, and the zod `pivot` arm declares it as a `retirementTombstone()`. Three pending changesets still read that key as the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`, and they publish verbatim into the `@object-ui/types` CHANGELOG before the objectui#10972 entry's correction is met. Each now carries one dated 2026-09-29 supersession note, appended at the end of the file, in the objectui#10877 / PR objectui#10891 form: a bold headline naming the date and objectui#10932, what holds now, the superseding entry by file and PR, and "the text above is kept as the reading of this change".

**Authorisation.** The maintainer's 2026-09-29 ruling, recorded on this card as comment `5883365010` (and on objectui#4356 as `5883360525`), quoted:

> You allow developers to append dated correction notes to pending .changeset files (appended only, no existing line or frontmatter edited).

## The three sentences and the appended notes

Each before-sentence was re-quoted from `main` `2eaf5be27` before writing.

### 1. `.changeset/10859-pivot-object-block-zod-arms.md`

Before: "`drillDown` is the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`"

Appended:

> ⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-29 — `drillDown` is retired on the `pivot` node — objectui#10932.** Later in this same release `drillDown` was retired on the `pivot` node on both faces: the TypeScript `PivotTableSchema.drillDown` is a `?: never` tombstone, and the `pivot` arm of `@object-ui/types/zod` declares `drillDown` as a `retirementTombstone()`, which refuses the key by name whatever it holds (`invalid_type` at `drillDown`, with a message naming `object-pivot`). So "`drillDown` is the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`" above no longer holds: the arm accepts no `drillDown` at all. Nothing ever drilled a `pivot` node; a pivot whose cells open the records behind a value is authored as `object-pivot`, whose `drillDown` is typed `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig`. The rest of the `PivotTableSchema` bullet stands, including "a member for member restatement of the TypeScript `PivotTableSchema`", because both faces retired the key together. `.changeset/10932-pivot-drilldown-retired.md` (PR objectui#10972) states what ships; the text above is kept as the reading of this change.

### 2. `.changeset/7352-drill-down-config-mirror.md` (its 2026-09-28 dated note)

Before: "its `drillDown` is this entry's `DrillDownConfigSchema`, so the opening paragraph's two referencing declarations are three for the release"

Appended:

> ⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-29 — the `pivot` arm no longer references this mirror —
> objectui#10932.** Later in this same release `drillDown` was retired on the `pivot`
> node on both faces: `PivotTableSchema.drillDown` is a `?: never` tombstone on the
> TypeScript face, and the zod arm declares it as a `retirementTombstone()`, which
> refuses the key by name whatever it holds. So "its `drillDown` is this entry's
> `DrillDownConfigSchema`, so the opening paragraph's two referencing declarations
> are three for the release" in the 2026-09-28 note above no longer holds: for the
> release the referencing declarations are the opening paragraph's two, `ChartSchema`
> and `ObjectDataTableSchema` (whose member extends this mirror per block,
> objectui#10685). The rest of that note stands: `PivotTableSchema` does have a zod
> mirror, so "`PivotTableSchema.drillDown` has no zod mirror at all" is still this
> change's reading, not the release's, and that mirror's `drillDown` member refuses
> the key rather than mirroring it. `.changeset/10932-pivot-drilldown-retired.md`
> (PR objectui#10972) states what ships; the text above is kept as the reading of
> this change.

### 3. `.changeset/10685-drilldown-per-block.md` (its 2026-09-28 dated note)

Before: "a validator does read the members of a `pivot` node's `drillDown`, and accepts `mode` there"

Appended:

> ⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-29 — the `pivot` node refuses `drillDown` whole now — objectui#10932.**
> Later in this same release `drillDown` was retired on the `pivot` node on both faces:
> `PivotTableSchema.drillDown` is a `?: never` tombstone, and the `pivot` arm of the zod mirror
> declares it as a `retirementTombstone()`, which refuses the key by name whatever it holds
> (`invalid_type` at `drillDown`). So "a validator does read the members of a `pivot` node's
> `drillDown`, and accepts `mode` there" in the 2026-09-28 note above no longer holds: the
> validator refuses the whole key before reading any member, so it accepts no `mode` on a `pivot`
> node. Nothing ever drilled a `pivot` node; a pivot drill is authored on `object-pivot`, whose
> `drillDown` type, `ObjectPivotDrillDownConfig`, refuses `mode` at the TypeScript door, as this
> entry says. `object-pivot` still has no zod mirror, so what this entry says of a stored
> `object-pivot` config stands. `.changeset/10932-pivot-drilldown-retired.md` (PR objectui#10972)
> states what ships; the text above is kept as the reading of this change.

## What the notes state, measured on `main` `2eaf5be27`

- `PivotTableSchema.drillDown?: never` on the TypeScript face; the zod arm's `drillDown` is `retirementTombstone(PIVOT_DRILL_DOWN_RETIRED)`, i.e. `z.never(...).optional()`, so any present value is refused at `drillDown` whatever it holds. The pin `pivot-drilldown-retired-10932.test.ts` ran 8 of 8 passed on this tree, including "the arm refuses it at `drillDown`, `invalid_type` against `never`" and "the refusal names the remedy, `object-pivot`, in one string on both channels".
- `DrillDownConfigSchema` is referenced by `ChartSchema` (`drillDown: DrillDownConfigSchema.optional()`) and by `ObjectDataTableSchema` (`drillDown: DrillDownConfigSchema.extend({`), and by no `pivot` member: two referencing declarations for the release.
- The node that drills is `object-pivot`: `ObjectPivotTable` passes `onDrillDown={handleDrillDown}` to `PivotTable`, whose `drillEnabled` is `typeof onDrillDown === 'function'`. `object-pivot` has no zod arm (every `object-pivot` mention under `packages/types/src/zod` is a comment or a message string; the control literals `z.literal('chart')` / `z.literal('pivot')` hit).

## Completeness sweep (pending changesets only)

Enumerated from `git ls-tree --name-only 2eaf5be27 .changeset/` (2325 `.md`, equal to the working-tree count):

- `pivot` (case-insensitive) AND `drillDown`: 10 files. Three are this PR's carriers and one is `10932-pivot-drilldown-retired.md` itself. The other six (`10528-grid-object-table-fetch`, `10778-dashboard-bus-readers`, `8885-object-chart-drilldown-title-compareto`, `8970-object-metric-shared-drill-drawer`, `9000-drill-columns-header-labels`, `9002-metric-drilldown-refusal`) were read: each speaks of `object-pivot` or the shared `DrillDownConfig` type, and none is made false by PR objectui#10972.
- Widened, `pivot` AND `drill` without `drillDown`: 4 more (`10789-render-time-filter-refusals`, `9024-pivot-drill-filter-composition`, `9137-dataset-drill-conjoin-widget-filter`, `dashboard-table-widget-polish-5827`), all about `object-pivot` drill filters or the cross-tab renderer; none false.
- `DrillDownConfigSchema`: 4 files, all inside the first set.
- Positive control: the three named carriers are hits of the first query.
- `7759-dashboard-header-global-filters-spec.md` is untouched; that note belongs to PR #10930 (objectui#4356 W4).

No same-class extra sentence was found, so no fourth note.
